title: MappingCondition
description: A condition of a mapping rule. All conditions of a rule must hold.

field.description: Name of the field of the input item. Not used by the amount operators.

value.description: Text for equals, contains and regex, a list of texts for oneOf, a number for amountEquals and two numbers for between.

trimNewLines.description: Ignore line breaks, repeated spaces and spaces around lines when comparing text.
